blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLM agents have made remarkable progress in robot manipulation, yet they suffer from expensive inference, dense step-by-step control, and tool bottlenecks. We introduce SOLVE, a training-free, versatile and efficient agent policy: a multimodal LLM agent writes a sparse, ordered sequence of 6-DoF end-effector keyposes per call, observes the result, and writes the next, while a motion planner interpolates between them. The agent decides the number and spacing of keyposes for both fast long-range motion and fine-grained manipulation. This granularity matches the sparsity of teleoperated manipulation: most demonstrations in DROID can be compressed into a few keyposes instead of dense actions. SOLVE grounds keyposes with sparse depth queries answered by noisy sources, such as multi-view triangulation, stereo, or monocular depth, and copes with that noise itself. It also improves from execution feedback, reflecting on its own rollouts and distilling a few rules per task. SOLVE reaches state-of-the-art performance of 74.5% on RoboDojo and 84.5% on RoboLab, with only $1.7 per episode on average, 12x less than previous dense-control agent policies. On a real robot, the same agent achieves an 88% success rate (75 of 85 episodes) over 16 challenging zero-shot tasks. Our project page is at https://serenos.github.io/solve-website.
blocks.zh: LLM代理在机器人操纵上取得了显著的进步,然而他们却遭受了昂贵的推断,密集的分步控制,以及工具瓶颈. 我们引入了SOLVE, 一个免费、多功能和高效的代理政策:一个多式LLM代理写着一个稀疏的、按序排列的每通电话6-DoF端效键, 观察结果,然后写下一个结果,而一个运动规划者在它们之间插入。 代理人决定键盘的数量和间隔,既用于快速远程运动又用于精细操纵. 这种颗粒性与电传操作操纵的相匹配:DROID中的大多数演示可以被压缩成几个密钥来代替密集动作. SOLVE用噪音源解答的稀有深度询问,如多视三角形、立体声或单相干深度,并应付这种噪音本身。 它还通过执行反馈有所改进,反思了自己的推出,并提炼出每项任务的一些规则. SOLVE在"RoboDojo"和"RoboLab"上分别达到74.5%和84.5%的先进性能,平均每集只有1.7分,比之前的密集控制代理政策还少了12分. 在真正的机器人上,同名特工在16个挑战性零镜头任务上取得了88%的成功率(85集中的75集). 我们的项目网页见https://serenos.github.io/solve-website。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Robot manipulation policies have progressed from small task-specific networks trained with reinforcement or imitation learning [ 51 , 26 , 71 , 14 ] to vision-language-action (VLA) models [ 3 , 22 , 35 , 1 ] and world-action models (WAMs) [ 27 , 7 , 25 ] , yet all remain data-hungry: they need large teleoperation corpora for each robot and benchmark, and transfer poorly beyond them.
Frontier multimodal LLMs offer a training-free alternative and can now control robots directly [ 64 , 56 , 69 , 32 ] , but current agents sit at one of two extremes.
Step-wise agents [ 69 , 56 , 64 ] issue one small step per model call, so every step costs seconds of latency and money, and errors compound.
Code-as-policy agents [ 40 , 55 , 19 ] instead generate programs over a primitive library, which becomes a bottleneck: uncovered tasks require new primitives, written by hand or searched offline [ 19 , 39 ] , and feedback arrives only when the program returns, too late to correct a failed step.
blocks.zh:
机器人操纵政策已经从经过强化或模仿学习培训的小型任务网络[51、26、71、14]发展到视觉语言行动模型[3、22、35、1]和世界行动模型[27、7、25],但所有这些网络都仍然缺乏数据:它们需要每个机器人和基准的大型远程操作公司,而且转移远远超出它们。
边境多式联运 LLMS提供一种免训练的替代品,现在可以直接控制机器人[64,56,69,32],但目前的特工坐落在两个极端中的一个.
分步操作的代理[69,56,64]每次模式调用都会发出一小步,因此每步花费一秒的延迟和金钱,以及出错复合.
代码即时政策代理[40,55,19] 转而在一个原始库上生成程序,这成为了瓶颈:被发现的任务需要新的原始人,用手写或从线下搜索[19,39],反馈只有在程序返回时才到来,为时已晚,无法纠正一个失败的步骤.

blocks.en:
This raises a key question: what action granularity is appropriate for an agent policy? We compress 57,534 successful DROID episodes [ 34 ] into end-effector keyposes joined by straight lines ( Fig. 1 b), and find that over 91% of the travel lies on segments longer than 5 cm, and that a grasp or release needs only 6 keyposes instead of 96 recorded actions.
We therefore hypothesize that, for an agent policy, a sequence of sparse end-effector keyposes suffices for manipulation, in place of a dense stream of actions.
blocks.zh:
这就提出了一个关键问题:何种行动颗粒性适合代理人政策? 我们把57,534个成功的 DROID 集 [34] 压缩成由直线(图 1 b)相接的终端-效果键盘,发现超过91%的行程位于5厘米以上的片段上,抓取或放出只需6个键盘,而不是96个被记录的动作.
因此,我们假设,就代理政策而言,一串稀少的终极效应键足以被操纵,以取代大量的行动。

blocks.en:
We present SOLVE, a training-free framework in which a multimodal LLM agent writes sparse, ordered end-effector keyposes, and a motion planner [ 57 ] executes straight-line motions between them ( Fig. 1 c).
Each keypose is an absolute 6-DoF grasp-point pose with a gripper command; one call specifies up to five keyposes, roughly one primitive such as approach, grasp, and lift, and the gripper actuates only upon arrival.
The agent decides how many keyposes to use, how far apart, and how fast: a single keypose for a long free-space motion, and short, slow ones near contact.
After each sequence, the agent inspects the outcome before predicting the next one, so visual feedback enters its reasoning at every primitive rather than only at the checks a program anticipates.
blocks.zh:
我们提出SOLVE,这是一个无培训框架,一个多式联运LLM代理在其中写出稀疏的,有命令的终端效应键盘,一个运动规划员[57]执行它们之间的直线运动(图1c)。
每个键盘是绝对的6-DoF抓取点姿势,带有抓取命令;一个呼叫指定了最多5个键盘,大致是一个原始的,如接近,抓取和起重等,抓取器只在到达时才起动.
代理人决定要使用多少个键盘,相距多远,速度多快:一个键盘用于长时间的自由空间运动,而一个短而缓慢的键盘接近.
在每个序列之后,代理在预测下一个序列之前检查结果,因此视觉反馈在每一个原始的而不是仅在一个程序预期的检查中进入其推理.

blocks.en:
Because each sparse keypose is an absolute commitment, it must be metrically accurate. SOLVE therefore grounds keyposes through sparse metric queries : the agent specifies the few pixels on which its next keypose depends, and a tool returns their 3D positions, each annotated with its measurement modality.
In RoboDojo and RoboLab simulation, which provide no stereo cameras, the tool triangulates each queried pixel across multiple views by epipolar matching, and falls back to monocular depth estimated by Depth Anything 3 [ 42 ] , scaled by the known table height, when no multi-view match is found; on the real robot, it directly uses depth from FoundationStereo [ 58 ] on a stereo infrared camera.
Over multiple rounds of keypose reasoning, the agent adapts to the resulting depth noise by itself.
On difficult tasks, the agent further improves from its own execution feedback without training: it reflects on rollouts from layouts disjoint from evaluation, and consolidates the notes from several rounds into at most five bounded rules per task, which are provided to it at test time.
blocks.zh:
因为每个稀有的密钥都是一种绝对的承诺,所以它必须是精确的。 因此,SOLVE通过少量的度量查询来计算密钥: 代理指定其下一个密钥套接字所依赖的几个像素,一个工具返回其3D位置,每个工具都带有其测量模式。
在不提供立体相机的RoboDojo和RoboLab模拟中,工具三边通过平面相配将每个被询问的像素通过多处视图进行解析,并倒回由深度Anything 3 [42]估计的单相深度,由已知的表高所缩放,当没有找到多相配时;在真正的机器人上,它直接从FoundationStereo [58]在立体红外相机上使用深度.
通过多轮键盘推理,特效会自行适应由此产生的深度噪声.
在困难的任务上,代理商在未经培训的情况下从自己的执行反馈中进一步改进:它反思从布局上推出与评价脱节的情况,并将几轮的笔记合并为最多5个限定规则,每个任务在测试时提供给它.

blocks.en:
Since no component of SOLVE is trained, and keyposes live in end-effector space while the planner resolves embodiment-specific execution, the same agent deploys on different robots without modification.
SOLVE achieves 74.5% on the dual-arm RoboDojo under the leaderboard’s metric ( Tab. 1 ) and 84.5% on the single-arm Franka RoboLab [ 63 ] .
On a real UR12e, it completes 75 of 85 episodes across 16 challenging zero-shot tasks ( Tab. 4 ), including table cleaning, peg-in-hole, sketch drawing, and playing Gomoku against a human.
It does so at $1.7 per episode on average, with one quarter of the model calls and 12 × \times lower cost than a step-wise agent ( Fig. 1 d).
blocks.zh:
由于SOLVE中没有任何组件经过训练,而键盘活在终端效应空间而计划者则解决了特有化身执行,因此同一种特效在不同的机器人上部署而无需修改.
SOLVE在双臂RoboDojo上获得74.5%的成绩,
在真实的UR12e上,它完成85集中的75集,横跨16个挑战性零镜头任务(Tab. 4),包括桌子清洁,入洞接接接,草图绘制,和玩出Gomoku来对抗人类.
它这样做平均为每集1.7分,四分之一的型号呼叫和12xxx\times的成本低于一个分步代理(图1d).

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We show that teleoperated demonstrations compress into a small number of keyposes and, building on this finding, propose SOLVE, a framework in which an LLM agent writes sparse, ordered keyposes for direct manipulation. • We propose sparse metric queries, combining cross-view epipolar matching with depth estimation to ground keyposes accurately and efficiently in 3D from RGB in simulation, and use stereo depth on the real robot. • We enable the agent to improve from rollouts, and show that SOLVE transfers without modification across robots and benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art results on RoboDojo, RoboLab, and a real robot at 12 × \times lower cost.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Vision-language-action (VLA) models [ 4 , 3 , 22 , 35 , 2 , 1 , 44 , 36 , 50 , 5 , 53 , 59 , 72 , 48 , 20 ] and imitation policies that predict action chunks [ 71 , 14 ] are trained on large teleoperation corpora to emit dense, high-frequency actions; recent work improves their spatial representations [ 50 , 73 , 62 ] and action tokenization [ 49 ] .
World-action models (WAMs) [ 17 , 60 , 8 , 27 , 38 , 74 , 31 , 7 , 41 , 37 , 46 , 66 , 6 , 25 ] additionally learn from video to predict future observations and derive actions from them.
On RoboDojo [ 12 ] , the best entries of both families reach 35% on the leaderboard and at most 23% on the Open dimension, whose tasks come without demonstrations.
SOLVE instead acts through sparse keyposes and requires no robot-specific training.
blocks.zh:
远景-语言行动(VLA)模式[4,3,22,35,2,1,44,36,50,5,53,59,72,48,20]以及预测行动块的仿真政策[71,14]都接受了大型远程行动公司发射密集高频行动的培训;近期的工作改善了它们的空间表现[50,73,62]和行动标志化[49].
世界行动模式[17、60、8、27、38、74、31、7、41、37、46、66、6、25]从视频中进一步学习,以预测未来的观测结果并从中得出行动。
在RoboDojo[12]上,两个家庭的最佳参赛人数在领导板上达到35%,在开放层面最多达到23%,他们的任务是没有示威的。
SOLVE则通过稀有的键盘操作,不需要机器人特定训练.

blocks.en:
A growing line of work builds policies around frontier LLMs with little or no training. Code-as-policy methods let the model write programs over perception and control primitives [ 40 ] ; recent systems benchmark coding agents [ 18 ] , structure programs as graphs rehearsed in simulation [ 9 ] , grow skill libraries by evolutionary search [ 45 ] , or rewrite the training code of neural policies [ 61 ] .
Agent as Policy [ 32 ] similarly writes programs at test time on a real arm. Harness methods wrap a model with tools, memory and recovery logic, steering a frozen VLA as a retryable or interruptible tool [ 70 , 10 , 15 ] or calling semantic tools such as grasp and align [ 43 ] .
Finally, some works use the model directly as a policy , issuing one end-effector target per call [ 69 , 56 ] , several absolute poses each executed for a single control step [ 64 ] , discrete motion units of a few centimeters [ 13 ] , or batches of relative, axis-aligned motion commands.
SOLVE is a direct policy in that every call observes the scene and outputs motion targets.
Unlike other direct policies, a call outputs an ordered sequence of absolute 6-DoF keyposes, placed with metric 3D measurements, that can span a whole primitive.
blocks.zh:
越来越多的工作围绕边境有限责任公司制定政策,很少或根本没有培训。 代码即时政策方法让模型编写程序凌驾于感知和控制原始人[40]; 最近的系统基准编码代理[18],模拟中排练出图表的结构程序[9],通过进化搜索来发展技能库[45],或者改写神经政策的培训代码[61].
Agent as Policy [32] 类似在测试时将程序写在正臂上. 利用方法用工具,内存和恢复逻辑来包裹一个模型,将被冻结的VLA作为可重试或可中断的工具来引导[70,10,15],或称为语义工具,如抓取和对齐[43].
最后,有的作品直接将模型作为政策来使用,每个调用[69,56]发布一个终端效果目标,数个绝对位每个执行一个控制步骤[64],数厘米的离散运动单元[13],或批次的相对轴相通运动命令.
SOLVE是一种直接的政策,因为每个电话都观察现场和输出运动目标.
与其他直接政策不同的是,一个调用输出一个绝对的6-DoF键盘的顺序,放入了度量衡3D,可以横跨整个原始.

blocks.en:
Sparsity itself is not new.
Keyframe policies predict the next gripper pose rather than a dense trajectory [ 30 , 54 , 23 , 21 , 24 , 33 ] , and bimanual policies condition on keyposes or skills [ 67 , 75 , 65 ] .
These methods learn from task demonstrations, and they extract keyframes with heuristics such as gripper state changes and near-zero joint velocities [ 30 , 54 ] , implicitly assuming that a few poses suffice; our analysis quantifies how many are needed per primitive and where this assumption fails.
VLM-based methods such as VoxPoser [ 28 ] , ReKep [ 29 ] , and PIVOT [ 47 ] are also training-free, but the model typically produces object-centric keypoints, constraints or value maps once, and a separate optimizer turns them into motion.
In SOLVE, the model itself writes end-effector keyposes at every call (hence keypose rather than keypoint).
blocks.zh:
平衡本身并非新鲜事。
关键框架政策预测下一个控制者所呈现的轨迹不是密集的轨迹[30、54、23、21、24、33],对关键人物或技能的双重政策条件[67、75、65]。
这些方法从任务演示中吸取了教训,它们提取出按键框,如抓取态变化和近零联动速度[30,54],隐含地假设,少数方法就足够了;我们的分析量化了每个原始方法需要多少以及这种假设失败的地方.
VLM基于VoxPoser [28],ReKep [29],和PIVOT [47]等方法也是无训练的,但模型通常一次生成以对象为中心的关键点,约束或值图,一个单独的优化器将它们转化为运动.
在SOLVE中,模型本身会在每个呼叫(因此键pose而不是键点)时写出端效键.

blocks.en: 3.2 Sparse, ordered keyposes
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 Sparse, 命令键盘

blocks.en:
We first measure how far demonstrations compress into keyposes joined by straight lines.
Keeping the first and last poses and every gripper event (a grasp or a release), we simplify position (interpolated linearly) and orientation (by slerp) jointly with Ramer–Douglas–Peucker [ 16 ] , adding the farthest frame as a keypose until every frame lies within a tolerance.
We apply it to RoboDojo’s teleoperated demonstrations and to 57,534 successful DROID episodes [ 34 ] , which human operators teleoperated on real Franka arms.

blocks.en:
Both compress alike ( Fig. 3 ).
A grasp or release spans a median of 56 recorded actions on RoboDojo (25 Hz) and 96 on DROID (15 Hz), as many as a policy imitating them at the recording rate must output; at 2 cm / 10 ∘ it needs only 4.9 and 6.0 keyposes, 11 × \times and 16 × \times fewer, and a DROID episode shrinks to a median of 13 keyposes, about one per second.
Over 91% of the travel lies on segments longer than 5 cm, and on DROID this share stays within 88–95% for every instruction verb.
The segments are genuinely straight: at 1 cm, 92.6% of DROID travel lies on segments whose path is at most 1.11 times their chord.
A short sequence of absolute targets thus describes most manipulation, and the dense motion can be left to the planner.

A keypose of arm a ∈ 𝒜 a\in\mathcal{A} is a target for its observed state ( T t a , g t a ) (T^{a}_{t},g^{a}_{t}) , k a = ( 𝐩 a , 𝜽 a , g a ) k^{a}=(\mathbf{p}^{a},\boldsymbol{\theta}^{a},g^{a}) : the world-frame position 𝐩 a ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{p}^{a}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} of the grasp point, its orientation 𝜽 a = ( pitch , roll , yaw ) \boldsymbol{\theta}^{a}=(\text{pitch},\text{roll},\text{yaw}) , and the gripper opening g a ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] g^{a}\in[0,1] .
The agent writes only the dimensions it wants to change; all others hold their current value in T t a T^{a}_{t} and g t a g^{a}_{t} , and naming dimensions of several arms moves them together.
One move_eef call carries an ordered sequence 𝒦 = ( k 1 , … , k n ) \mathcal{K}=(k_{1},\dots,k_{n}) with n ≤ n max n\leq n_{\max} , a cap sized to one primitive, such as approach; descend and close; lift, which our demonstration analysis puts at five to six keyposes per grasp or release.
Three choices make the interface easy for an LLM to use. Absolute targets: each keypose is the pose the arm should reach, not an increment, so the agent never has to plan intermediate waypoints of a long move. Arrive, then actuate: a gripper command takes effect only after the arm reaches its keypose, so “go there and grasp” is a single keypose. Agent-set speed: each keypose may carry a ramp r r , the number of environment steps used to accelerate toward it and to brake at it; the agent chooses a long ramp to carry liquid or set an object down gently, and a short one to strike or knock something over.
The agent thus decides the number, spacing and speed of keyposes: one keypose at full speed for a long free-space move, several short and slow ones near contact.
The executor Ψ \Psi turns a keypose sequence 𝒦 \mathcal{K} into joint commands without any learning. The move to each keypose is split into short segments of bounded translation and rotation, each solved for a joint path by a motion planner [ 57 ] and chained.
If a segment cannot be reached, the sequence stops before it and the feedback e m e_{m} reports which keypose failed, so the agent can replan.

blocks.en:
Placing keyposes requires metric 3D grounding, but only at a few task-relevant points, not dense scene depth.
Through query_points , the agent selects pixels Q = { ( c j , u j ) } j Q=\{(c_{j},u_{j})\}_{j} needed for its next keypose, such as a cup rim or a socket hole, and Φ \Phi returns their world points X j X_{j} ( Eq. 2 ).
The tool uses calibrated RGB views in simulation with no stereo cameras, as described below, and additionally the stereo depth of the wrist camera on hardware ( Sec. 4.1 ).

通过查询_点,代理选择了像素Q={(c j,u j)}{(c j)}{(u j)}}}}}{(j)}}} 用于它的下个密钥, 如杯边或套接字孔, \\ Phi 返回它们的世界点 X j \ (Eq. 2 ) 。
该工具在模拟时使用校正的RGB视图,没有立体相机,如下文所描述,此外还有硬件上手腕相机的立体深度(sec 4.1.

blocks.en:
We triangulate each query pixel by calibrated two-view matching along its epipolar line.
To accommodate the large viewpoint and scale differences between head and wrist cameras, we evaluate depth hypotheses using plane-induced patch warping and normalized cross-correlation rather than comparing fixed image windows.
This directly matches the agent-selected pixel without requiring it to be a detected keypoint or computing a dense disparity map.
We first try the other current cameras, then recent wrist frames with stricter acceptance thresholds to account for scene motion.
A point is accepted only when the match passes confidence, uniqueness and texture checks; otherwise, we use the depth model fallback below.
Implementation details and comparisons with feature matching are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
我们通过校准双视线 沿它的极地线对每个查询像素进行三角测量。
为了适应头相机和手腕相机之间的大视角和尺度差异,我们利用平面所引发的补丁扭曲和正态交叉对接来评价深度假说,而不是比较固定的图像窗口.
这直接匹配了代理选中的像素,而不要求它是一个被检测到的键点或计算出一个密集的相差图.
我们首先尝试其他的相机, 然后最近的手腕相框 有更严格的接受阈值 来说明场景运动。
只有在匹配通过信任,独特性和纹理检查时才接受一个点;否则,我们使用下方的深度回落模型.
补充材料中提供了执行细节和特征匹配的比较。

blocks.en:
When triangulation fails, e.g . , on textureless surfaces or points visible in only one camera, the tool uses depth predicted by Depth Anything 3 [ 42 ] from all current views and their camera calibration.
We correct the scale per view using reference depths obtained by intersecting table-pixel rays with the known table plane.
The model runs once per observation o t o_{t} , shared by all queries; its depth is accurate to a centimeter but smooths edges and thin parts.

blocks.en: 3.4 Self-evolution with experience

blocks.en:
The keypose interface, the executor and the queries are shared by all tasks and robots.
Task-specific knowledge enters only through the two optional inputs of Eq. 1 , the guide G G and the experience notes E E .
blocks.zh:
密钥pose接口,执行器和查询由所有任务和机器人共享.
任务特定知识只通过Eq. 1的两种可选输入输入,指南G和体验说明E E.

blocks.en:
Where a benchmark provides demonstrations, a guide G G explains one demonstration of the task in text and keyframes.
The LLM writes it offline from the demonstration’s grasp-point trajectory and camera frames, following a fixed structure: the demonstration’s stages and its hard parts, and then for each stage its goal, the moves as performed in move_eef values, the grasp geometry, a check that tells when the stage is done, and head and wrist keyframes where the text cites them.
Every statement is tagged as general, such as which arm grasps which part of an object and in what order, or as specific to the demonstrated layout, such as its coordinates;
A guide thus conveys a strategy in the agent’s own action space rather than a trajectory to replay, since object poses differ in every evaluated layout.
Tasks without demonstrations, such as those of RoboLab and the real robot, run without a guide ( G = ∅ G=\varnothing ).
blocks.zh:
在基准提供演示时,G指南用文本和关键框架解释一个任务演示。
LLM从演示的抓取点轨迹和相机框上下线,遵循一个固定的结构:演示的阶段及其硬部分,然后是每个阶段的目标,动作中的动作_eef值,抓取几何,一个显示舞台完成时间的检查,以及文字引用它们的头和手腕键框。
每个语句被标记为一般语句,例如哪个臂能抓住物体的哪一部分并按什么顺序,或按所显示的布局,如其座标的具体位置;
因此,一个指南在代理人自己的行动空间中传达一种策略,而不是重放的轨迹,因为物体在每种评估的布局中都不同。
没有演示的任务,如RoboLab和真正的机器人,没有向导(G = ∅ G=\varulty)就运行.

blocks.en:
Experience notes E E let the agent improve on a task from its own execution feedback, without parameter updates.
On layouts that do not overlap with the evaluation layouts, the agent runs R R rollouts of a task one after another.
After each one, with its history h m h_{m} still in context, it is told whether it succeeded, shown the task’s current notes, and answers with one more tool call z m z_{m} , update_experience : a short summary of why the rollout succeeded or failed, and operations that add, update or delete notes.
The prompt asks only for lessons that decided the outcome of the task or of a sub-step, stated with the situation in which they hold rather than with coordinates, and requires any lesson that adds verification, retries or extra motion to bound it in attempts or steps, since the step budget t max t_{\max} ends most failed episodes.
A note set 𝒩 \mathcal{N} holds a bounded number of short notes, each with a few frames.

blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en:
All experiments share the agent code, tools and executor; only the robot’s constants change (kinematic model, camera calibration, robot description in the prompt).
RoboDojo uses guides (except on Open) and self-evolution, RoboLab only self-evolution, and the real robot neither: each episode is a single zero-shot attempt.

RoboDojo使用向导(Open上除外)和自演,RoboLab只使用自演,而真正的机器人也不使用:每集都是一次零镜头尝试.

blocks.en:
RoboDojo-Sim [ 12 ] comprises 42 tasks across five dimensions on two ARX-X5 arms, with demonstrations except for Open tasks.
We use only RGB observations, follow the official evaluation protocol, and report success rate (SR) and partial-credit score.
blocks.zh:
RoboDojo-Sim [12] 由两个ARX-X5臂上跨越5个维度的42个任务组成,除了开放任务之外还有示威.
我们只使用RGB观察,遵循官方评价协议,并报告成功率(SR)和部分得分.

blocks.en: RoboLab [ 63 ] comprises 120 tasks on a Franka; we use its external and wrist RGB views and follow the official protocol, without guides.
blocks.zh: RoboLab [63] 包含120个任务在弗兰卡上;我们使用其外部和手腕的RGB视图并遵循官方协议,没有向导.

blocks.en:
We also run SOLVE on a single-arm UR12e with a wrist stereo camera and a fixed third-person camera; query_points additionally reads the wrist camera’s stereo depth (details in the supplementary material).
We design 16 tasks ( Tab. 4 ) along the Long-Horizon, Precision, Memory and Open dimensions and beyond them: in-context imitation (rebuilding a structure that a person builds once in front of the robot), playing Gomoku against a person, and folding a shirt.
Several are hard: peg-in-hole insertion leaves only 1 mm of clearance, and in drawing the agent picks up the pen itself, so the offset from the grasp point to the pen tip is unknown.
No task has pre-collected demonstrations, guides, notes or task-specific code.
We run five episodes per task and ten of shirt folding, 85 in all.
blocks.zh:
我们还在一臂UR12e上运行SOLVE,配备有手腕立体相机和固定的第三人称相机;查询-点额外读取了手腕相机的立体深度(补充材料中的细节).
我们沿着"长相","精密","记忆"和"开放"维度等设计出16个任务(图4),以及超越它们:内文仿真(重建一个人在机器人前所建立过的结构),玩出Gomoku对一个人,并折叠一件衬衫.
有几种是硬的:插入孔后只留下一毫米的通关量,在绘图时,特务自己取出笔来取出,因此从取出点到笔尖的相抵是未知的.
没有任务预先收集演示,引导,注释或任务特定代码.
我们每个任务运行5集 和10个衬衫折叠,总共85集。

blocks.en:
Table 2 lists the tools. The prompt describes the robot, the keypose convention and the tools, then gives the instruction, G G and E E ; each later turn adds the current images, the arms’ state and the last call’s feedback.
One move_eef call carries at most n max = 5 n_{\max}=5 keyposes (raised to 30 for drawing on the real robot), and the executor splits the move to each keypose into segments of at most 5 cm and 20 ∘ .
For self-evolution, each note set is written over R = 5 R=5 rollouts and holds at most ten notes of at most 110 words and two frames each.
We write S = 3 S=3 note sets per task, so the merge sees R ​ S = 15 RS=15 rollouts, and keep at most L = 5 L=5 rules of at most 70 words each; the final call yields eight general rules.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 3: RoboLab. Success rate (%) on the 120 tasks by difficulty tier. SOLVE: five episodes per task. ‡ Observes depth.

blocks.en:
In the official evaluation ( Tab. 1 ), SOLVE with experience notes and GPT-6 Astra reaches 74.5%, 18.1 points above the best entry, GO-3 Nano Preview (agent with a world-action model), and 24.1 above the strongest coding agent, PyRUA-Lean [ 55 ] .
It leads in every dimension, while GPT-6 Astra (RoboProbe) drives the same model step by step to 22.5%: the 52.0-point gap comes from the agent, not the model.
The margins are largest where learned policies must generalize: 61.7 and 64.4% on standard and randomized Generalization, 15.3 and 23.4 points above the best entries, and 72.8% on Open, which has no demonstrations and where no VLA or world-action model exceeds 22.9%.
Its text history tracks what it has seen and done, giving 94.3% on Memory.
Precision rises from 4.0% for the step-wise agent to 81.5%, ahead of GO-3 Nano Preview (76.0%), as each keypose lands on a measured point.
blocks.zh:
在官方评价(表1)中,有经验说明和GPT-6 Astra的SOLVE达到74.5%,比最佳条目高出18.1分,GO-3"纳诺预览"(具有世界行动模式的代理),比最强的编码剂PyRUA-Lean [55].
它在每个维度中领先,而GPT-6 Astra(RoboProbe)则一步一步地驱动相同的模型到22.5%:52.0分的空隙来自代理,而不是模型.
所学政策必须概括的边际幅度最大:标准化和随机化一般化为61.7%和64.4%,最佳条目以上为15.3%和23.4%,开放度为72.8%,没有演示,没有VLA或世界行动模式超过22.9%。
它的文字历史跟踪它所看到的和所做的,在记忆上给出94.3%.
在GO-3 Nano预览(76.0%)之前,精度从相继剂的4.0%上升至81.5%,因为每个键盘在被测量的点上着陆。

blocks.en: With the cheaper GPT-6.1 Sol (mean of two runs, five episodes per task), SOLVE reaches 61.5% without notes and 68.0% with them, both above every leaderboard entry.
blocks.zh: SOLVE以更便宜的GPT-6.1 Sol(平均为两跑,每跑一次5集),无音符的SOLVE达到61.5%,有68.0%的音符,两者都高于每个导板条目.

blocks.en:
Averaged over RoboDojo and RoboLab at list prices, SOLVE costs $0.5 per episode with GPT-6.1 Sol and $1.7 with GPT-6 Astra, 42 × \times and 12 × \times less than the $21.1 of GPT-6 Astra Direct [ 56 ] , a step-wise agent whose cost is public for 50 RoboDojo episodes.
On these, SOLVE (Astra) succeeds in 74% of them instead of 26% with 36 instead of 154 model calls per episode.
blocks.zh:
平均在RoboDojo和RoboLab之间,按列表价格计算,SOLVE每集花费0.5美元,使用GPT-6.1 Sol和1.7美元使用GPT-6 Astra,42相和12相和少于GPT-6 Astra Direct[56]的21.1美元,这是分步走的代理商,其成本为50出RoboDojo的相片公开.
在这些方面,SOLVE(Astra)以74%的成绩成功,而非26%的成绩,每集36分而非154分的型号呼叫.

blocks.en:
On RoboLab ( Tab. 3 ), without guides or any change beyond the robot’s constants, SOLVE succeeds in 84.5% of the episodes, 27.4 points above the best entry, SenseNova-RoboRSI [ 52 ] , which uses GPT-6 Astra directly as the policy; its first rollout without notes already reaches 79.8%.
The gap widens from 25.6 points on simple to 31.8 on complex tasks: SOLVE loses only 2.6 points between them, the other methods 8.8–20.9.
Self-evolution improves 16 of the 30 tasks that the first rollout found hard (28 more successes); the rest fail on large or rounded objects that slip from the gripper, or on the step budget.
blocks.zh:
在RoboLab (Tab. 3)上,没有向导或超出机器人常数的任何变化,SOLVE在84.5%的剧集中取得了成功,27. 4分高于最佳入围,SenseNova-RoboRSI [52],它直接将GPT-6 Astra作为政策;其首次推出时没有音符的推出已经达到了79.8%.
差距从简单25.6分扩大到复杂任务的31.8分: SOLVE之间只损失了2.6分,其他方法 8.8–20.9 (中文(简体) ).
自发式改进了首次推出后发现困难的30个任务中的16个(另外28个成功);其余则在从抓取器滑走的大或圆形物体上或步入预算上失败.

blocks.en: Table 4: Real UR12e , zero-shot. Successful episodes, and model calls, keyposes and minutes per episode.
blocks.zh: 表4:真实UR12e,0发. 成功的剧集,以及模型调用,键盘和每集的分数.

blocks.en:
SOLVE succeeds in 75 of 85 real-robot episodes (88%) and completes each of the 16 tasks at least once ( Tab. 4 ), with 21.9 model calls and 6.6 minutes per episode.
It again sets the keypose density itself: three or four for a grasp and place, up to 30 per call when it draws.
In context, it rebuilds a six-cup pyramid and a five-part block castle after watching a person build each once; when the person has built the castle but not yet scattered the blocks, it keeps watching until they do. It also wins all ten Gomoku games against a person.
When an attempt falls short, it adjusts the next one from the images rather than repeating it: after a broken test stroke it lowers the pen by 1.5 mm, and after a failed top-down grasp of a plate it tilts the gripper to grasp the rim.
No task-specific code prompts these corrections (reasoning quoted in the supplementary material).
Its ten failures come from a shirt sliding along with the gripper, an insertion released before both pegs are seated and then blocked by a protective stop, or a drawing that would drive the wrist camera into the table.
blocks.zh:
SOLVE成功出道于85个真机器人集中的75个(88%),并至少完成16个任务中的每个任务一次(Tab. 4),每集21.9个型号呼叫和6.6分.
它再次设定了键盘密度本身:三到四个用于抓取和位置,在抽取时每个呼叫最多可达30个.
在上下文中,它重建了一座由6Cup的金字塔和一座由5个部分组成的城堡,在观看一个人每人建造一次之后;当这个人已经建造了城堡但尚未将街区分散时,它一直监视到他们建造. 它也赢得了十场对一个人的游戏。
当一次尝试不足时,它会从图像中调整下一场而不是再重复一次:经过一次断开的测试后将笔放下1.5毫米,在盘子的上下接力失败后,会使抓取器倾斜来抓住轮回.
没有针对具体任务的代码提示这些更正(补充材料引用的理由)。
它的十种失败来自一件衬衫与钳子一起滑动,一种在两根钉子都坐好之前放出并被保护站所堵住的插入,或者一种能将手腕相机推入桌子的图画.

blocks.zh: 4.3 违约

blocks.en:
Replacing its step-wise end-effector actions with sparse keypose sequences, run by our executor, while still estimating targets from the RGB images, raises the average success rate from 22.9 to 49.5%.
It gains most on Memory (38.7 to 92.5%), Long-Horizon (8.2 to 37.5%) and Precision (4.0 to 32.5%), where the step-by-step baseline runs out of steps before finishing.
blocks.zh:
以我们执行者运行的稀有键盘序列取代其相继的端效应动作,同时仍然从 RGB 图像中估计目标,将平均成功率从22.9%提高到49.5%。
它在记忆(38.7%至92.5%)、长视线(8.2%至37.5%)和精度(4.0%至32.5%)方面收益最大,在这些方面,分步骤基线在完成前已耗尽。

blocks.en:
Measuring targets with query_points raises it to 62.2% at about the same cost, mostly where a centimeter matters: Precision rises from 32.5 to 60.0% and standard Generalization from 40.0 to 56.7%.
Offline, on 1,182 queries of the Precision tasks with simulator depth as reference, intersecting a pixel’s ray with the table errs by 51.6 mm (median) and object silhouettes by 20.0 mm, while epipolar matching errs by 4.6 mm on the 37% of pixels it accepts; on holes, where silhouettes fail, it is about ten times more accurate (2.8 vs . 36.4 mm on deposit coin ).
Online, triangulation and the Depth Anything 3 fallback raise the share of successful episodes from 55.5% with silhouettes alone to 59.8%, on par with simulator depth.
blocks.zh:
用查询点测量目标,大约以同样的成本将目标提高到62.2%,大多在一厘米重要的地方: 精度从32.5%上升到60.0%,标准通化从40.0 %上升到56.7%.
离线时,在1,182次以模拟器深度作为参考的精度任务查询中,一像素射线与表相接误差为51.6毫米(中位数)和20.0毫米,而上极相接误差为4.6毫米,其接受的像素的37%;在洞中,硅相接失败,准确度大约是10倍(存款硬币的2.8对36.4毫米).
在线,三角和深度 Anything 3倒计时,成功事件的比例从55.5%,单是硅胶,提高到59.8%,与模拟深度相当。

blocks.en:
Merged notes raise the average to 68.3% at no extra cost, mainly on Open (+15.0), Precision (+12.5) and Long-Horizon (+6.2).
Raw notes add only 3 points in two independent writing runs, and their gains depend on what each run writes; notes that urge more verification make the agent run out of steps or give up.
Merging three runs into at most five bounded rules per task removes such losses; on RoboLab, self-evolved notes likewise raise success from 79.8 to 84.5% ( Tab. 3 ).
blocks.zh:
合并纸币将平均成本提高到68.3%,不增加成本,主要在Open(+15.0),精度(+12.5)和Long-Horizon(+6.2)上.
Raw notes在两个独立写作运行中只加了3分,他们的得分取决于每个运行的写作内容;敦促更多校验的注解使得代理器耗尽了步骤或放弃.
将三项任务合并为最多五项有限度的规则可以消除这种损失;在RoboLab, 自行编写的说明同样将成功率从79.8%提高到84.5%(表3)。

blocks.zh: 4.4 分析

blocks.en:
Figure 5 compares the keyposes SOLVE writes per episode with those a teleoperated demonstration of the task needs.
The two counts agree closely: medians of 39.5 vs . 40.3 per task, a rank correlation of 0.90 over 34 tasks.
This is not merely because both grow with the number of objects: with the demonstration’s grasps and releases held fixed, the partial rank correlation remains 0.69.
blocks.zh:
图5将每集的键盘SOLVE写作与任务需要的远程操作演示进行比较.
两个计数非常一致:中位数为39.5对每任务40.3,分级关系为0.90对34个任务.
这不仅是因为两者随着物体数量的增加而增加:随着演示的把握和释放被固定,部分等级关系仍然为0.69。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Keyposes per call. (a) Success rate and (b) model calls per episode against the keyposes allowed per move_eef call.
blocks.zh: 图6:每个呼叫的键盘。 (a) 成功率和(b) 每集对每次移动-eef呼叫允许的键盘进行模式调用。

blocks.en:
We cap a move_eef call at one, three or five keyposes and change nothing else ( Fig. 6 ).
Success is unchanged (69.8, 67.8 and 68.2%), but model calls per episode fall from 56.6 to 36.2 and 33.7, 40% fewer.
A higher cap would save little more in simulation: even with five allowed, the agent sends one to three keyposes in 89% of its calls and five in only 3%, as it often splits a primitive across calls to look in between.
Drawing needs many more: on the real robot, a cap of 30 lets the agent draw a portrait’s 305 keyposes in 15 move_eef calls instead of at least 61, each saving seconds of model latency.
blocks.zh:
我们在一、三、五个键位上加注一个动作,不另作改动(图6)。
成功率不变(69.8,67.8%和68.2%),但每集的模特电话从56.6%下降到36.2%和33.7%,减少了40%.
更高的上限在模拟中省得不多:即使允许5个,经纪人也会在89%的呼叫中发出1到3个键盘,只有3%的键盘发出5个键盘,因为它经常将一个原始的呼叫分割开来,互相看一看。
画画需要更多:在真正的机器人上,一个30的上限让代理在15个move_eef调用中绘制一张肖像的305个密钥,而不是至少61个,每个省下秒的模型潜伏.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Evolving the notes over more rounds. Bold: SR per five rounds; dashed and dotted: our merged rules and no notes.
blocks.zh: 图7:更多回合的注解变化。 粗体:每五轮的SR;破碎和点:我们的合并规则而无音符.

blocks.en:
We let the agent keep evolving its notes for 20 rounds, each running one new layout per RoboDojo task ( Fig. 7 ).
Starting from 59.8% without notes, success reaches 66.0, 68.4, 69.0 and 65.6% after 5, 10, 15 and 20 rounds: it peaks near our frozen merged rules (68.3%) and then declines.
It is also unstable: single rounds swing between 57.1% and 76.2%, while three runs with the frozen merged rules average 68.6%.
The notes explain both: as they fill up, the agent stops adding and rewrites them around the latest episode, so that most notes end up describing one particular episode and earlier lessons are overwritten.
Merging avoids this: it keeps only layout-free lessons that recur across independent runs and freezes them, reaching the peak from the start and holding it across runs.
blocks.zh:
我们让特工不停地演化20发的笔记,每发都运行一发新的布局来完成RoboDojo任务(图7).
从59.8%的无音符开始,成功率在5、10、15和20个回合后达到66.0%、68.4%、69.0%和65.6%:它最接近我们被冻结的合并规则(68.3%),然后下降。
同样不稳定的是,单发子弹在57.1%至76.2%之间摇摆,而三发子弹与被冻结的合并规则相通,平均为68.6%。
笔记对两者都有解释:当他们填满后,代理商停止了在最新一集前后添加并重写,这样大多数笔记最终都会描述出一出特定的一集,而更早的课会被覆写.
合并可以避免这种情况:它只保留无布局的教训,这些教训在独立跑道之间反复出现并被冻结,从头到尾都达到峰值,并保持到跨跑道.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
An LLM agent does not need dense, step-by-step control to manipulate. Teleoperated demonstrations compress to a few keyposes per grasp or release, and SOLVE lets a multimodal LLM agent write such keyposes directly, grounds them with sparse metric queries, and refines them with notes from its own rollouts, without training.
SOLVE reaches 74.5% on RoboDojo and 84.5% on RoboLab, ahead of every leaderboard entry, at $1.7 per episode, and 88% over 16 zero-shot real-world tasks.
Sparse, ordered keyposes are an effective and economical interface between LLMs and robot control.
blocks.zh:
一个LLM剂不需要密集的分步控制来操纵. 远程操作演示压缩到每个抓取或释放的几个密钥,SOLVE让多模式LLM代理直接写出这种密钥,用稀有的度量查询来证明它们,用自己推出的笔记来细化它们,而不经过培训.
SOLVE在"RoboDojo"上达到74.5%,"RoboLab"上达到84.5%,领先于"领跑板"每集1.7分,超过16个零镜头现实世界任务88%.
Sparse,订购的按键是LLMS和机器人控制之间的有效而经济的接口.

blocks.en: Some real tasks require force or continuous feedback that keyposes cannot provide, and each model call takes seconds; a next step is to combine keyposes with a learned low-level policy for contact-rich segments.
blocks.zh: 一些真正的任务需要键盘无法提供的力或持续的反馈,每个模型调用需要几秒钟;下一步是将键盘与学习到的低级政策相结合,用于接触丰富的部分.

blocks.en:
The agent is called through an OpenAI-compatible Responses API and must answer every turn with exactly one tool call; if a call has invalid arguments, such as a sequence of more than five keyposes, it is rejected with an explanation and the agent is prompted again.
Each call carries a note , one or two sentences on what the agent sees and why it acts, which is logged and kept in the history ( Sec. E.2.1 quotes such notes).

blocks.en: C.1 Keypose compression of demonstrations

blocks.en: This section details the analysis of Sec. 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 本节详述了对第3.2条的分析。

blocks.en:
RoboDojo provides 100 teleoperated demonstrations for each of its 34 tasks with demonstrations, recorded at 25 Hz on two ARX-X5 arms; we convert each arm to the grasp point used by move_eef , count the keyposes of both arms together, and skip an arm that moves less than 2 cm and 5 ∘ .
For DROID [ 34 ] we take all 57,639 successful episodes (15 Hz, Franka with a Robotiq 2F-85) and drop those that move less than 2 cm and 5 ∘ or last under one second, leaving 57,534 episodes and 18.7M frames, without subsampling.
We use DROID’s recorded end-effector pose, detect gripper events with hysteresis (closed above 0.4, open below 0.2, ignoring flips shorter than three frames), and smooth positions over about 0.2 s before measuring path lengths, which changes the shares of long segments by less than 0.3 points.
blocks.zh:
RoboDojo为其34个任务提供100个远程操作的示威,
对于 DROID [34] 我们拍摄了所有57,639个成功集 (15 Hz, Franka with a Robotiq 2F-85) 并放下那些移动不到2cm和5 QQ 或最后一秒以下的,留下了57,534个集和18.7M帧,没有子样本.
我们使用 DROID 记录的末端效果器姿势, 检测有歇斯底里现象( 封闭于 0. 4 以上, 打开于 0. 2 以下, 忽略了短于 三帧的翻转) 的抓取事件, 在测量路径长度前, 平滑位置超过 0. 2 s , 改变长段的分数不到 0. 3 分 。

blocks.en:
On RoboDojo, every task has at least 80% of its travel on straight segments longer than 5 cm, the lowest being push T (80.2%) and pour liquid into cup (80.4%).
The 13,144 failed DROID episodes compress similarly: 88.9% of their travel lies on long segments, against 91.3% for successes.
Moving DROID’s recorded pose 15 cm along the tool axis, in case it is the flange rather than the fingertips, raises the median keyposes per episode from 13 to 15 and leaves the share at 91.2%.
The analysis measures geometric compressibility only: neither the DROID nor the RoboDojo demonstrations record the states of the objects, so the compressed trajectories cannot be replayed to measure their success.
blocks.zh:
在机器人上 道场,每项任务有至少80%的出行时间为直行段长于5厘米,最低的是推倒T(80.2%)并倒入杯中(80.4%).
13,144个失败的DROID事件同样压缩:88.9%的旅行是长段的,成功率为91.3%。

blocks.en: C.2 Epipolar matching of query pixels
blocks.zh: C.2 查询像素的极地匹配

blocks.en:
query_points must return the 3D point of the pixel the agent chose, often the center of a hole or a point on a rim, from cameras that differ greatly in direction and scale.
We compare our epipolar matching ( Sec. 3.3 ) with the alternatives offline, on pixels that the agent actually queried, using as reference the 3D point measured on simulator depth for the same pixel.
blocks.zh:
查询_点必须返回代理选择的像素的3D点,往往是一个孔或一个点的中央,来自方向和尺度差异很大的相机.
将我们的平极匹配(sec. 3. 3 )与离线的替代物进行比较,在物剂实际询问的像素上,以模拟器深度为同一像素测量的3D点作为参考.

blocks.en:
Depth hypotheses lie on the query ray from 5 mm below to 36 cm above the table, 1.5 mm apart.
At each one, the 15 × 15 15{\times}15 gray-level window around the query pixel is warped into the second view through a horizontal plane or a plane facing the query camera, whichever matches better, and compared by normalized cross-correlation with Gaussian weights, so that the pixels nearest the query decide.
A match is accepted if its score s s is high, if it stands out from the best score elsewhere on the ray, s r s_{r} , by the ratio ρ = ( 1 − s r ) / ( 1 − s ) \rho=(1-s_{r})/(1-s) , which rejects repeated structures, and if the window has texture (a gray-level spread of at least 4).
We require s ≥ 0.85 s\geq 0.85 and ρ ≥ 1.5 \rho\geq 1.5 for the current cameras and the previous observation, and s ≥ 0.9 s\geq 0.9 and ρ ≥ 2 \rho\geq 2 for older wrist frames (up to six observations back), since objects may have moved; a second view must be at least 2 cm or 8 ∘ 8^{\circ} away from the query camera.

深度假说位于查询射线上从表下5毫米到表上36厘米,相去1.5毫米.
在每张相机上,查询像素周围的15×15 15 出15个灰色平面的窗口会通过水平平面或面对查询相机的平面被扭曲为第二视图,其中以哪个比对更好,并通过与高斯加权的正交相比较,使最接近查询的像素决定.
如果比分 s 为高,如果比分高于射线上其他地方的最佳分数 s s s s s s s s s r , 则接受比分 → ( 1 - s s r ) / ( 1 - s ) / rho / ( 1 - s s r ) / ( 1 - s) , 拒绝重复结构, 如果窗口有纹理( 灰相差至少为 4) .
我们要求当前相机和前一次观测的相机为0.85 s\geq 0.85 和 ^ 1.5 s\rho\克 1.5 s; 旧腕框为0.9 s\geq 0.9 s\geq 和 ^ 2 s\rho\geq 2 ,因为物体可能已经移动;第二个视图必须离查询相机至少2 cm或 8 \\ 8\circ ) 。

blocks.en:
Triangulating from feature matches between two views is a natural alternative, but it suits our queries poorly: the head and wrist cameras see the scene from very different directions and at very different scales, so local features often fail to match between them, and the pixel the agent queries, such as the center of a hole, need not carry a matchable feature at all, so its depth would have to be borrowed from matches nearby.
Our epipolar matching instead searches along the ray of the queried pixel itself and warps the window by the plane-induced homography, which absorbs the differences in viewpoint and scale.
blocks.zh:
从两个视图之间的特征匹配中三角化是一个自然的可选方案,但它很适合我们的询问:头相机和手腕相机从非常不同的方向和非常不同的尺度上看到场景,所以局部的特征往往无法在它们之间相匹配,而代理查询的像素,比如一个孔的中心,则根本不需要携带一个可匹配的特征,因此它的深度必须从附近的匹配中借用.
我们沿着被询问的像素本身的光线进行极地相匹配,然后用平面所引发的同位素来扭曲窗口,这吸收了观点和尺度的差异。

blocks.en:
On all 1,182 query pixels of the Precision tasks ( Tab. 7 ), epipolar matching answers 37% of the pixels, using the other cameras and the wrist frames of the last six observations, at a median error of 4.6 mm; two thirds of its answers lie within 1 cm.
This is about four times more accurate than measuring object silhouettes (20.0 mm) and ten times more than intersecting the pixel’s ray with the table (51.6 mm).
The gap is largest on holes, where a silhouette has no surface to measure: 2.8 vs . 36.4 mm on deposit coin .
Past wrist frames raise the coverage from 24% to 37% at no loss of accuracy, since a moving wrist camera provides new baselines for free.
blocks.zh:
在精密任务的全部1,182个查询像素上(Tab. 7),上极相匹配的答案为37%的像素,使用其他相机和后6个观测结果的手腕相框,中间误差为4.6毫米;其三分之二的答案在1厘米以内.
这比测量物体的硅光度(20.0毫米)准确了大约4倍,比像素的射线与表相接(51.6毫米)准确了10倍.
空隙在孔上最大,在孔上,一个硅胶没有地表可以测量: 2.8 vs 36.4mm 在存款硬币上.
以往的手腕相框将覆盖率从24%提高到37%,不丧失准确性,因为移动的手腕相机提供了免费的新基线.

blocks.en:
Pixels on textureless, slanted or specular surfaces have no reliable match; there the tool reads the depth estimated by Depth Anything 3, accurate to about a centimeter, or the table plane, and tags each answer with its source.
The agent therefore gets an answer for every pixel and knows which ones to trust to millimeters: the full chain answers all 1,182 pixels, not only the 37% that epipolar matching accepts, at a median error of 5.4 mm, close to that of epipolar matching alone, and puts 64% of them within 1 cm, against 36% for object silhouettes and 10% for the table plane ( Tab. 7 ).

blocks.en: C.3 Evolving notes over more rounds
blocks.zh: C.3 联合国 更多回合的音符变化

blocks.en:
In the experiment of Fig. 7 , the agent keeps evolving its notes over 20 additional rounds instead of merging and freezing them ( Sec. 4.4 ), using layouts that differ from the evaluation layouts.
The resulting notes explain why performance stops improving and fluctuates: each task keeps at most ten notes, and once full, the agent mostly overwrites existing notes rather than adding new ones, replacing general lessons with accounts of the latest episode.
For example, a play stacking toy note on grasping square pieces between occupied pegs ends up reading “This success placed all three squares between a tall ring stack and a blue block…”.
Merging keeps only lessons that several independent rollouts support, stated without layout details, and freezing stops the latest episode from rewriting them, which is why SOLVE merges and freezes its notes.

blocks.en: C.4 Failure analysis on RoboDojo
blocks.zh: C.4 机器人道场故障分析

blocks.en:
We classify every failed episode of our runs with notes on layouts 0–4 of seed 0, standard and randomized variants (269 evaluated episodes per model), by its primary cause and by how it ended ( Fig. 8 ).
The cause is labeled by an LLM from evidence extracted from the trace: grasp-monitor events, planner refusals, the sources of the queried points, and the reason and hindsight that the agent states when it gives up.

No failure is primarily due to a wrong 3D measurement, and none to memory: where the agent fails, it usually knows where things are and what remains to be done, but cannot hold or seat them.

blocks.en: Appendix D Prompts
blocks.zh: 附录D 提示

blocks.en:
Table 8 summarizes the prompts of SOLVE on RoboDojo, which are written in English.
The agent reads the first three at every call; the last four are used offline, once per rollout or per task.
On other robots only the robot description in the prompt changes ( Sec. 4.1 ).
Three principles recur across them. Measure, do not guess: every target is placed from query_points on distinctive pixels, and each reading comes with its source. Steps are scarce: the prompts name the step budget, ask for final poses rather than small increments, and require every check or retry the agent or its notes add to be bounded. General, not layout-specific: guides tag what holds in any layout, and notes and rules state situations and actions without coordinates.

代理在每次呼叫时都会阅读前三;后四被下线使用,每次推出或每次任务一次.
在其他机器人上,仅在即时变化中的机器人描述(sec 4.1.
三个原则相互重复。 度量,不要猜测:每个目标都从查询点被放置在有特色的像素上,每个读取都随其出处而来. 步骤很少:提示点名步骤预算,要求最后的姿势而不是小的递增,并要求每一次检查或重试代理人或其笔记后再加限制. 常规,而非特定布局:向导标记任何布局中持有的东西,注释和规则说明没有坐标的状态和行动.

blocks.en: E.1 Controlled comparisons on a public subset
blocks.zh: E.1 联合国 对公共子集的控制比较

blocks.en:
To separate the factors behind SOLVE’s results, we rerun it with one factor changed at a time on a fixed subset: the 50 RoboDojo episodes whose step-wise GPT-6 Astra Direct runs are public [ 56 ] , ten tasks on seed 0 (41 standard and 9 randomized episodes).
One of them, layout 4 of imitate sorting sequence , never starts because the simulator marks it unstable, so every configuration is evaluated on the same 49 episodes.
Unless stated otherwise, the configuration is that of the paper: GPT-6.1 Sol at effort xhigh , at most five keyposes per call, task guides, and the frozen merged rules, task and general, of every task.
All configurations of Tab. 9 run in the same batch, including the default SOLVE configuration, and are compared with it episode by episode (exact McNemar test).
The subset leans toward Long-Horizon (20 of 50 episodes) and has one task each from Precision, Memory and Open.
With 49 episodes, only large differences can be resolved: two configurations must differ by about ten episodes to be statistically distinguishable.
blocks.zh:

Removing either the guide or the notes costs six episodes (33 to 27), and removing both costs 14 ( p = 0.009 p=0.009 ).

blocks.en: E.2 Real robot
blocks.zh: E.2 联合国 真正的机器人

blocks.en:
The setup follows Sec. 4.1 : a UR12e with a Robotiq 2F-85; a wrist Orbbec Gemini 335Lg and a fixed third-person Intel RealSense; the same agent, tools and executor as on RoboDojo; wrist stereo depth and cross-camera triangulation; and no pre-collected demonstrations, guides, notes or task-specific code.
For drawing, the cap n max n_{\max} is raised from five to 30 keyposes per move_eef call, which long strokes need; the portrait instruction states this cap explicitly.
Each task is given as one natural-language instruction.
When a task involves a person, the agent lets the person act with wait and sees the frames recorded meanwhile.
Success is verified by a person against a fixed criterion per task, such as a stable four-level stack, a fully seated workpiece or five marks in a row, and confirmed on the final camera frames; 75 of the 85 episodes succeed ( Tab. 4 ).
Whether a task ran with GPT-6.1 Sol or GPT-6 Astra was assigned randomly before the experiment and kept fixed; the prompt was also finalized before any real-robot run and was never tuned on these tasks.
We also tried the GPT-6 Astra (RoboProbe) baseline [ 69 ] once per task; a single episode usually took more than 30 minutes at a high API cost, and none succeeded, so we did not scale it up or report it in Tab. 4 .
Every episode is judged for success; per-episode statistics (model calls, keyposes, queried pixels and time) in Tab. 4 and Tab. 10 are computed over the episodes with full logs, one or more per task. Table 10 details each of the 16 tasks, and Appendix F shows one successful episode per task.
blocks.zh:
设置如下: 第4.1条:一款UR12e与机器人2F-85;一款手腕Orbbec双子座335Lg和固定的第三人称Intel RealSense;与RoboDojo上相同的代理,工具和执行器;一款手腕立体深度和跨相机三角;没有预收集的演示,向导,注释或任务特定代码.
在绘图时, max n max} 上限从每次移动- eef 调用 5 个键到 30 个键位, 这需要长打; 肖像指令明确显示此上限 。
每项任务都作为一种自然语言教学。
当一项任务涉及一个人时,代理人会让此人等待行事,并同时看到记录的帧.
成功由一个人根据每个任务的一个固定标准进行验证,如稳定的四层堆放,一个全席工作台或一行五个马克,并在最终相机相框上确认;85集中的75集成功(Tab. 4).
任务是否与GPT-6.1 Sol 或 GPT-6 Astra 一起运行,在实验前被随机分配并被固定下来;在任何真机器人运行之前,提示也被最终确定,从未对这些任务进行调试.
我们还尝试了GPT-6 Astra(RoboProbe)的基线[69]个每任务一次;一个单集通常需要30多分钟,而高昂的API成本,没有一次成功,因此没有放大或以Tab报告. 4 (韩语).

blocks.en:
A queried pixel takes the FoundationStereo [ 58 ] depth of the wrist camera’s infrared pair around it, then cross-camera triangulation between the wrist and third-person cameras where that depth is missing, and falls back to the table plane, each answer tagged with its source and warned when noisy.
The wrist camera is calibrated by hand-eye calibration (Tsai–Lenz) on a chessboard, and the third-person camera’s pose is calibrated from chessboards viewed jointly by both cameras.
blocks.zh:
一个被询问的像素将腕相机的红外相机的深度取到周围,然后在缺少深度的手腕相机和第三人称相机之间交叉相机三角相机,然后倒回平面,每回答案都用它的源头作标记,并发出警报。
手腕相机通过手眼校正(Tsai-Lenz)在棋盘上进行校正,第三人称相机的姿势由两个相机共同查看的相机来校正.

These columns are computed over the logged episodes of each task. Success: successful episodes of the task over all its episodes, five per task and ten for the shirt. Last row: means over all logged episodes, computed as in Tab. 4 (KP / move: total keyposes over total sequences), and total successes over all 85 episodes.

blocks.en:
Keyposes per move_eef call range from 1.6 for insertion, where the agent moves in short sequences and looks after each, to 20.3 for the portrait ( Tab. 10 ).
A grasp and place takes three or four keyposes, sent in sequences of 2.3–2.6 on the Long-Horizon tasks, close to RoboDojo, while drawing grows with the length of the strokes: 45 keyposes for a house, 125 for the rocket and 305 for the portrait.
Model calls vary far less, from 11 to 33 per episode, so the cost of an episode is set by how often the agent needs to look, not by how much it draws.
blocks.zh:
每个move_eef调用键盘从1.6个插入,即代理人按短序移动并照顾每个,到20.3个肖像(Tab. 10.
抓取和位置取出三到四个键盘,以2.3–2.6的顺序发送到长胡同任务上,靠近RoboDojo,而绘图则会随着中风的长度而增长:一栋房子用键盘45个,火箭用键盘125个,肖像用键盘305个.
模型调用差别要小得多,从每集11到33个不等,因此一集的费用是由经纪人需要多久看一次来决定,而不是由它抽出多少.

blocks.en:
The ten failures fall on shirt folding (4 of 10), precision (3 of 10) and open tasks (3 of 25).
Most concern contact: an insertion releases before the pegs are seated, or a shirt slides along with the gripper during a one-arm fold.
The others concern the clearance of the robot’s own body: lowering a pen grasped near its tip would have brought the wrist camera into collision with the table, and the robot stopped before contact; this is also why the portrait and Gomoku instructions, written before the experiment like all others, ask to grasp the pen near its end.
As on RoboDojo, these call for force or tactile feedback at contact and a collision check of the whole arm and camera before a sequence is sent.
blocks.zh:
这十起故障发生在衬衫折叠上(4起为10起),精度(3起为10起)和开口任务上(3起为25起)。
最受关注的接触:一臂折叠时,在钉子就座前放入放出,或用衬衫滑放与夹子相接.
其他人则关心机器人自身身体的清除问题:把紧接其尖端的钢笔放下,会使手腕相机与桌子相撞,机器人在接触前就停止了;这也是为何肖像和Gomoku指示像所有其他人一样在实验前要求将钢笔接上近端.
和RoboDojo一样,这些呼吁要求在接触时发出武力或触觉反馈,并在发送序列之前对整个手臂和相机进行相撞检查.

blocks.en: A logged episode takes 6.6 minutes on average; a model call takes a median of 11.7 s and executing its keypose sequence 6.1 s, so inference, not motion, sets the pace, which confines SOLVE to quasi-static scenes ( Sec. 5 ).

blocks.en: E.2.1 The agent’s reasoning
blocks.zh: 经济及社会理事会 代理人的推理

blocks.en:
Every tool call carries the agent’s note on what it sees and why it acts ( Appendix B ).
We quote notes where the agent does more than the instruction spells out.
blocks.zh:
每个工具呼叫都附有代理人关于其所见所闻及其行为原因的说明(附录B)。
我们引用说明 代理做 超过说明。

blocks.en:
In the Gomoku endgame, before its first move, the agent plans two lines at once: “Black has the diagonal three C3, D4, E5 as well as F4 and F5; I choose F6 to make a diagonal four and a vertical threat.” The person blocks the diagonal at G7, and the agent turns to the second line: “White’s new move at G7 confirmed; black draws an x on the empty F3, so that F3–F6 form a four open at both ends.” An open four cannot be blocked at both ends; the person blocks F7 and the agent wins at F2.
In the full game it adapts in the same way: “White blocked the three on the diagonal at its lower-right end. I switch to the horizontal line”, and at the end it races the person: “White’s latest move forms a four above, still not five. It is black’s turn: I draw an x at the measured, still empty right end, completing five horizontally.”
blocks.zh:
在"Gomoku endgame"中,在第一次移动前,代理商一并计划出两行:“黑色有对角线3个C3,D4,E5以及F4和F5;我选择了F6来做对角线4和垂直威胁。” 此人阻挡了G7的对角线,代理商转至第二行: " 白色在G7的新动作被确认;黑色在空F3上画出一克X来使F3-F6在两端形成四个开口". 开口的四分站不能两端被屏蔽;人块F7,代理商以F2获胜.
在完全的游戏中,它以同样的方式适应:"白色将对角上的三个挡在了它的下右端. 我切换到水平线,"最后它会和人比赛: " 白人的最新举动是以上四段,仍不是五段。 现在轮到黑人: 我画一个X 在测量, 仍然是空的右端, 完成五个水平。 “

blocks.en: In the castle task, the person first built the castle but did not yet scatter the blocks. Rather than start rebuilding, the agent keeps watching: “The first demonstration showed the finished castle but lacked the scattering step that the task requires; keep the arm still and watch this part as well.”
blocks.zh: 在城堡的任务中,人物首先建造了城堡,但还没有分散出街区. 代理商不但没有开始重建,反而不断监视: “第一次示威显示了完成的城堡,但缺乏任务需要的分道扬镳的步骤;保持手臂不动并观看这部分。 “

blocks.en: Folding the shirt, the gripper reports an empty grasp on the thin hem. The agent does not retry blindly: “The thin hem may be held even though the gripper reports nothing. I will make a small vertical lift and check whether the fabric follows before retrying.” “The images confirm that the hem lifted despite the empty-grasp report. I will carry the lower hem in an arc over the shirt’s midpoint to fold the lower half upward.”
blocks.zh: 撕开衬衫, 抓手报告说,一个空 抓住了薄的母鸡。 代理商不会盲目重试: “即使钳子不报告,薄的螺旋可能仍被扣住。 我将做一个小的垂直起重机,并在重新试验之前检查织物是否遵循。” “这些图像证实,尽管报告是空的,但直升机仍被抬起。 我将把下半身抬入衬衫中点的弧中, “

blocks.en:
In every drawing task the agent first draws a short test stroke, looks at it, and adjusts the pen height by millimeters: “The top view shows the lower half of the C touched too lightly and the line is broken. Lower the pen by only 1.5 mm and complete these three straight strokes, without adding lateral pressure.” Copying the rocket, it measures each marker separately after each regrasp: “The red nib is about 2.4 mm shorter below the grasp than the black nib. I will draw the two straight red nose edges at the corresponding contact height”, and later “The blue nib is another 1.5 mm shorter at this grasp.”
For the portrait it respects the cap of the instruction exactly, noting that its last drawing call “has exactly 30 keyposes”.
blocks.zh:
在每次绘图任务中,代理首先会绘制出一个短的测试中风,查看它,并用毫米来调整笔高: “顶部视图显示,C的下半部触动过轻,线断了。 将笔放下只下1.5毫米,完成这三道直打,而不会增加横向压力。” 在复制火箭时,它会在每个重力后分别测量每个标记: “取出红色的指针比取出黑色指针短约2.4毫米。 我将在相应的接触高度上划出两个正红鼻子边缘”,然后是“蓝色的鼻子在这个接力上又短了1.5毫米。 “
就肖像而言,它完全尊重指示的上限,指出其最后的绘画呼号“只有30个键盘”。

blocks.en: In the shell game the agent states its goal before the person starts, “observe which cup the cap is hidden under, and continuously track that cup’s position during the shuffle”, and confirms it on lifting the first cup it chose: “The red cap has appeared from under this cup, confirming that the tracking was correct.”
blocks.zh: 在壳牌游戏中,代理商在人开始前说明其目标, " 观察将盖子藏在下方的哪个杯子,并在洗牌时不断跟踪该杯子的位置",并在举起它选择的第一个杯子时确认: “红帽从这个杯子下出现,证实追踪是正确的。 “

blocks.en: In insertion trial 1 the agent lowered the workpiece 4 mm into the holes, released it and lifted; the arm then entered a protective stop. It measures the result, gives up rather than waiting for a correction it cannot make, and states why and what it should have done: “The pin workpiece is upright on the receiving workpiece and the gripper is open and clear, but the final height measurements indicate that the pegs are not fully seated. The robot is now in protective-stop safety mode, so I cannot safely correct the insertion.” Hindsight: “The insertion should have been checked for actual downward movement of the workpiece at the first contact step. A better alignment check and verified peg engagement were needed before releasing.” In the two successful trials it stops at first contact and lets gravity seat the workpiece: “The pin is now supported at the hole block, and its small movement relative to the jaws suggests contact. I will not push farther: I will release it to settle naturally.” “I will lower another 7 mm to establish roughly 1 cm of engagement, then release rather than press the shoulder against the receiver.” This is the kind of lesson that the experience notes of Sec. 3.4 distill on RoboDojo.
blocks.zh: 在插入第1次试验时,特工将工作台4毫米放入洞口后放出并取出;然后手臂进入了保护站。 它衡量结果,放弃而不是等待它无法作出的纠正,并且指出它为什么和应该做什么: “接发接发的接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接发接 机器人现在处于保护-停止安全状态,因此我无法安全地纠正插入。” 后视: " 应在接触第一步检查插入器是否实际向下移动。 在释放之前,需要进行更好的调整检查并核实挂钩情况。” 在两次成功的试验中,它首先停止接触,然后让重力座上工作台: “针被支持在洞口,相对于下巴的小运动表明接触。 我不会更进一步推: 我将释放它,自然解决。” “我将再降低7毫米,以便确定约1厘米的接战,然后放出而不是按住肩膀来对付接收器。” 这是经验中记述的3.4Sec在"机械道道"上的分馏.

blocks.en: E.3 RoboTwin 2.0
blocks.zh: E.3 机器人Twin 2.0

blocks.en:
RoboTwin 2.0 [ 11 ] has 50 bimanual tasks on the Aloha-AgileX robot and a public leaderboard.
Its entries are trained on 50 demonstrations per task in clean scenes and tested in two settings: Easy, the same clean scenes, and Hard, randomized scenes with distractor objects, new textures and lighting, and a lower table.
Hard thus asks whether a policy still works when the scene looks different from its training data.
blocks.zh:
RoboTwin 2.0 [11] 在Aloha-AgileX机器人上拥有50个双人任务和一个公共领导板.
它的条目在清洁场景中每个任务50个演示都经过培训,并在两个场合测试: 简单,同样干净的场景,以及硬的,随机的场景,带有分心对象,新的纹理和照明,以及一个更下层的桌子.
因此,很难问当场景与其培训数据不同时,一项政策是否仍然有效。

blocks.en:
We run SOLVE with the same agent, tools and executor and with GPT-6.1 Sol, using only the RGB images of the head and wrist cameras, ten episodes per task and setting (1,000 in all).
As on RoboDojo, it reads a guide written from one demonstration of each task; unlike on RoboDojo, its notes are not merged in advance but written after every episode for the later episodes of the same task.
Two small additions handle the platform: the prompt says that a grasp shows only in the images, since RoboTwin’s gripper reading always reads closed after a grasp command, and the table height, which varies between scenes, is measured once at the start by triangulating table points between the cameras.
blocks.zh:
我们用同样的代理、工具和执行器运行SOLVE,并使用GPT-6.1 Sol,只使用头部和手腕相机的RGB图像,每个任务和设置10集(总共1 000集)。
与"机器人道"一样,它读取了从每个任务的一个演示中写出的一个指南;与"机器人道"不同的是,它的笔记不是预先合并的,而是在同一个任务的后几集的每集后写出.
两个小的加法处理平台: 提示说抓取只显示在图像中, 因为RoboTwin的抓取器读取总是在抓取命令后读取关闭, 而不同场景的表高, 由相机之间的三角表点在开始时测量一次.

blocks.en:
SOLVE succeeds in 94.6% of the episodes in Easy and 95.0% in Hard ( Tab. 11 ).
In Easy it is on par with the best entry (95.3%); in Hard it leads the best entry by 10.2 points.
Randomization does not hurt it at all ( + 0.4 +0.4 points), whereas every leaderboard entry in Tab. 11 loses from Easy to Hard, by 3.4 to 50.3 points.
The reason is how each acts: a learned policy maps pixels to actions and has seen only clean scenes, so clutter and new textures shift its input, whereas SOLVE names the objects it needs, measures them and plans from the measurements, so a distractor only changes which pixels it asks about.
blocks.zh:
SOLVE在"Easy"的94.6%和"Hard"的95.0%(图11.
在Easy语中,它与最佳条目相同(95.3%);在Hard语中,它以10.2分领先最佳条目。
随机化完全不会伤害到它(+0.4+0.4分),而Tab. 11中的每个前导板条目都会从Easy到Hard输出,以3.4到50.3分.
原因在于每个动作:一个学习到的政策映射出像素到动作,只看到了干净的场景,所以杂乱无章地和新的纹理会转移其输入,而SOLVE则将它所需要的对象命名,测量它们和从测量中规划,因此一个分心器只改变它要求的像素.

blocks.en:
Almost all of the 52 failures are again about contact: an object slips, tips over or is pushed away, often out of view, and the agent gives up after searching for it; they concentrate on place dual shoes , where placing the second shoe often knocks over the first.
An episode takes 8 model calls at the median and costs about $0.17.
Within ten episodes per task and so close to the ceiling, the notes give no measurable gain.
blocks.zh:
几乎所有的52个失败都是关于接触的:一个物体滑倒,小费过关或被推走,经常出视线,代理商在寻找后放弃;他们专注于放置双鞋,放出第二只鞋往往会敲倒第一只.
一集按中位数需要8个模型呼叫,成本约为0.17.
每个任务在十集之内,而且如此接近上限,说明没有带来可衡量的收益。

blocks.en:
Ten episodes per task, instead of the leaderboard’s 100, leave about one point of uncertainty on the overall rate but much more on a single task.
SOLVE reads one demonstration per task instead of training on 50 and uses an API-served model, so the comparison is between approaches rather than between policies trained on the same data.
blocks.zh:
每个任务十集,而不是领导板的100集,给总体比率留下了约一分的不确定性,但更多的是单项任务。
SOLVE阅读了一次任务演示,而不是50次培训,并使用API服务模式,因此比较是在方法之间,而不是在同一数据上培训的政策之间。
